description: Source code for AndroidAptCompiler class implementing SourceGeneratingCompiler, responsible for compiling Android annotation processing (APT) within the IntelliJ IDEA environment. Contains methods for preparing, generating, and validating compilation items, as well as handling resource directories and validity states.

classes.name: AndroidAptCompiler
classes.description: Main class implementing annotation processing compiler for Android projects within IntelliJ IDEA.

classes.name: AndroidAptCompiler.AptGenerationItem
classes.description: Represents a generation item for Android APT compilation, encapsulating module, manifest, resources, target, package info, and validity state.

classes.name: AndroidAptCompiler.MyValidityState
classes.description: Validity state class tracking resource names, platform tools revision, package info, and other parameters for incremental compilation.

classes.name: AndroidAptCompiler.PrepareAction
classes.description: Computable class that prepares generation items by analyzing modules and their Android facets.

methods.name: getPresentableFile
methods.description: Returns null; not used for presentation.

methods.name: isToCompileModule
methods.description: Determines if a module should be compiled based on build configuration and Maven status.

methods.name: getGenerationItems
methods.description: Returns an array of generation items by running a read action to prepare them.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Performs code generation for given items, updating progress indicator.

methods.name: doGenerate
methods.description: Internal method that executes the actual generation process, handling temporary directories, messages, and file copying.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the compiler, based on AAPT filename.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Always returns true; validation is not implemented.

methods.name: createValidityState
methods.description: Creates a new validity state object from input data.

methods.name: getResourceDirForApkCompiler
methods.description: Returns the resource directory for APK compilation, either custom or default.

methods.name: getCustomResourceDirForApt
methods.description: Returns custom resource directory if specified in properties.
